mode.title: Hopeless Pursuit
mode.description: The hardest challenge of UCN DELUXE, a super buffed version of 50/20 no death coin that pushes your skills to their limits.

mode.title: Bloodbath in two runs
mode.description: The most popular former top 1 level of Geometry Dash, one of the biggest collab levels and predecessor of Bloodlust.

mode.title: Perfect Golden Freddy half oxygen
mode.description: Perfect Golden Freddy but getting jumpescared by Perfect Phantom Foxy, making you play with half of your oxygen, which makes your gameplay look way darker and makes oxygen management way more crucial.

mode.title: Perfect Golden Freddy
mode.description: Super Golden Freddy with the Perfect Mode challenge enabled, tests the limits of your skillsets and tries to reach perfection, but it's not quite there.

mode.title: Golden Freddy true perfect mode
mode.description: The Golden Freddy preset but with True Perfect mode enabled. Changes characters mechanics and is overall harder due to the speed required and that the game gives you less power than needed.

mode.title: Funtime Gala very hard mode 5:56
mode.description: Funtime Gala with the very hard mode enabled, alternig some characters' mechanics and making the overall gameplay more tighter powerwise.

mode.title: There's a robot kidnapped in my vent all challenges
mode.description: Hyper Golden Freddy all challenges but not closing the top vent door, since you can avoid Bidybab jumpescaring you by not checking the cameras on 2 second intervals, which makes Nightmare Chica more rng dependent and the overall gameplay way tighter.

mode.title: 50/20 long nights all death coin routes
mode.description: 50/20 mode from UCN DELUXE with the long nights challenge enabled but you have to complete the night 7 times, with each time buying the death coin for a different purpose.

mode.title: Pure Greed
mode.description: 50/20 mode from UCN DELUXE but with the death coin bought but not used and the coin cap of 99 coins reached at 6 am.

mode.title: The UCN Gauntlet
mode.description: Beating the main maxmodes of UCN, UCN Deluxe and UCN: Recode in a row, deathless.
